definitions.explanation: A deep, dark shade of brown resembling the color of something scorched. Literally 'burnt brown.' Used for colors of clothing, hair, furniture, and other items.

examples.japanese: {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{革靴|かわぐつ}→革靴：15433_kawagutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought dark brown leather shoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}めた→染める：04253_someru⟧。
examples.english: She dyed her hair dark brown.

examples.japanese: {焦|こ}げ{茶色|ちゃいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}っている→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: The dark brown wooden table matches the atmosphere of the room.

notes:
USAGE:
Also written as {焦|こ}げ{茶色|ちゃいろ} with the same meaning. Functions as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective when modifying nouns: {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鞄|かばん} (a dark brown bag). Part of the traditional Japanese color system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焦|こ}げ{茶色|ちゃいろ} (dark brown — extended form)
- {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ (dark brown hair)
- {焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧ (dark brown leather)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}→茶色：02915_chairo⟧: brown — the standard, lighter brown
- ⟦{栗色|くりいろ}→栗色：21884_kuriiro⟧: chestnut brown — a warm, reddish-brown shade
